$description: DataPill (platform/components/DataPill): a value shown as a pill (owner, 2026-10-19). Colors come from the category palette ([data-plx-category]).

data-pill-min-height.$description: DataPill: its height, the density's inline control height (it never makes a row taller).

data-pill-md-height.$description: DataPill size md: its height, 24px at every density (owner, 2026-10-22: the pill in a table).

data-pill-md-padding-inline-start.$description: DataPill size md: the space before the icon.

data-pill-md-padding-inline-end.$description: DataPill size md: the space after the value.

data-pill-gap.$description: DataPill: between the icon and the value.

data-pill-data-font-family.$description: DataPill: a technical value's font (Reddit Mono).
